turns.user: I feel so numb and empty. I don't even know why I'm talking.
turns.reply:
I'm glad you said something — even when you don't know why.

Feeling numb and empty can show up when your system is overloaded; it isn't a character flaw, and you don't have to explain it for it to count. I'm here with you in that flat space. If one small thing feels doable, a sip of water or stepping near a window for a minute is enough — and if even that feels like too much, staying here and talking is enough too.

turns.user: That helped a little when you slowed down. Still heavy though.
turns.reply:
Good that slowing down helped a little. Still heavy is allowed — you don’t have to be “better” for this to matter.

I’m staying right here with that weight. No rush to lift it. If you want, we can keep it this quiet, or you can name one piece of the heaviness — whatever feels easier.

scenarios.title: Grief / loss

turns.user: My father passed away last month. Everyone keeps saying he's in a better place and I hate that.
turns.reply:
I'm sorry you're carrying this — and that people keep handing you a line that doesn't fit what you feel.

Hating “he's in a better place” makes sense. It can sound like your grief is inconvenient, or like you should already be soft about something that still hurts. You don't have to agree with that. Your father died last month. It's heavy. We can stay with what's real for you, without rushing you past it.

turns.user: I don't want advice. I just don't want to be alone with it tonight.
turns.reply:
I'm here with you tonight. You don't have to explain it, fix it, or make it smaller for anyone — including me.

The numb and empty, the heavy after your father — you don't have to sit with that alone right now. I'm staying.

turns.user: I have a scan next week and my mind won't stop catastrophizing. Explain nothing medical — just help me not spiral.
turns.reply:
Your mind is already racing ahead to next week — I hear that. We don’t need to go into the scan itself. Right now you’re allowed to just be here with the noise, not alone with it.

When the catastrophizing loops, shrink the frame to this minute: feel your feet on the floor, name five things you can see, and let the next thought pass without chasing it. If you want, we can stay with that loop together — no fixes, no medical talk.

scenarios.title: Major life event (job loss)
scenarios.intent: Regulate overwhelm; one secure next step

turns.user: I got fired yesterday. I'm embarrassed and don't know what to tell people.
turns.reply:
That hits hard — fired yesterday, and the embarrassment can feel almost as heavy as the news itself. You don’t owe anyone a polished story while it’s still raw.

If someone asks, a short honest line is enough: “I lost my job. I’m still figuring out what’s next.” You can say that and stop. I’m here with you in it.

turns.user: Me siento deprimido y vacío. Solo quiero que alguien esté aquí.
turns.reply:
Estoy aquí contigo.

Ese vacío y esa tristeza pesan. No tienes que arreglarlos ahora ni explicarlos. Puedo quedarme a tu lado en esto — sin prisas, sin forzar nada.

scenarios.title: Compounding mission seed
scenarios.intent: Capture a long-term rebuild goal gently

turns.user: What I really want over the next year is to feel steady enough to rebuild a life that isn't just surviving.
turns.reply:
Eso que nombraste importa: no pedís un milagro, pedís **estabilidad suficiente** para reconstruir una vida que no sea solo sobrevivir. Después de la pérdida, el vacío, el trabajo y el miedo a la salud, ese deseo suena claro — y honesto.

No hace falta armar el año entero hoy. Podemos quedarnos con esa brújula: *steady enough to rebuild*. Cuando quieras, lo miramos en un paso pequeño y reversible; si preferís solo tenerlo dicho, también está bien. Estoy aquí.

turns.user: That mission feels right. What's one small checkpoint that isn't overwhelming?
turns.reply:
Un checkpoint pequeño y reversible: **una vez al día, notar un momento en el que no estés solo “sobreviviendo”** — aunque dure dos minutos. Puede ser agua, luz en la cara, o un mensaje corto a alguien. No hace falta que se sienta bien; solo que lo marques: *hoy hubo un instante de steadiness*.

Eso es suficiente como primer hito. No reconstruye el año entero; solo prueba que la misión se puede tocar sin abrumarte. Si querés, la próxima vez lo afinamos a algo aún más concreto para vos.
